resolved_last_edition.call: Yes if no named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 15 October 2026, that SpaceX has removed or disabled the in-motion speed restriction on military-grade Starlink terminals used by Ukrainian forces; no if such a report is posted by that deadline.
resolved_last_edition.note: Axios and Kyiv Post on 15 October reported Starshield restored to full capacity and in-motion service restored before the deadline.

resolved_last_edition.call: Yes if Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral names Flávio Bolsonaro the winner of the 25 October 2026 presidential runoff; no if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is named the winner, or if no runoff winner is named.

Yes if the Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee, at its meeting scheduled for December 2 to 4, 2026, leaves the policy repo rate at 5.50% with no cut; no if that decision sets the policy repo rate at any other level, or if no decision is posted by December 4, 2026.

Yes if the International Energy Agency or an IEA member energy ministry posts, by 16:00 UTC on 22 October 2026, a dated withdrawal of remaining oil stocks pledged under the March 2026 Collective Action; no if no such post by that deadline.

Yes if a named official source or named news outlet reports, by 16:00 UTC on 16 October 2026, that at least 300,000 tonnes of Russian diesel has been loaded onto tankers under the US Treasury energy-sector waiver announced on 9 October 2026; no if no such report is posted by that deadline.
